te: The Crete earthquake occurs with a maximum Mercalli intensity of XI (Extreme), causing a destructive tsunami that affec…
dz: 克里特岛地震发生时最大Mercalli烈度为XI (Extreme),引发破坏性海啸,影响利比亚和埃及海岸,特别是亚历山大. 数千人被杀.
de: The Crete earthquake occurs with a maximum Mercalli intensity of XI (Extreme), causing a destructive tsunami that affects the coasts of Libya and Egypt, especially Alexandria. Many thousands are killed.

t: 罗马篡位者普罗克皮乌斯贿赂了从君士坦丁堡经过的两个军团,并宣布自己为皇帝.
te: Roman usurper Procopius bribes two legions passing by Constantinople, and proclaims himself emperor.
dz: 罗马篡位者普罗克皮乌斯贿赂了从君士坦丁堡经过的两个军团,并宣布自己为皇帝.
de: Roman usurper Procopius bribes two legions passing by Constantinople, and proclaims himself emperor.

t: 罗马皇帝瓦伦丁尼安 我得知阿勒曼尼人已经越过了莱茵河并入侵了高卢.
te: Roman Emperor Valentinian I learns the Alemanni have crossed the Rhine and invaded Gaul.
dz: 罗马皇帝瓦伦丁尼安 我得知阿勒曼尼人已经越过了莱茵河并入侵了高卢.
de: Roman Emperor Valentinian I learns the Alemanni have crossed the Rhine and invaded Gaul.
